title: A ranked queue under a ceiling
description: Two loan reviews ranked by impact under a department ceiling: the review with the higher impact runs; the other fits the run cap and not the ceiling, and stops as RESOURCE_REQUIRED. This case is one evaluation. The recorded sequence `numbers` takes the same look, says which dimension, how much was needed and what was left, and then takes the next run: the run cap is set again, the ceiling is not, and the review stops on the ceiling again.
